lessons.daily_focus: Choose font pairing and hierarchy so candy name, flavor, and tagline have clear importance.
lessons.daily_learning_target: I can use font pairing and hierarchy so my candy text is clear and intentional.
lessons.source_evidence: Candy Brand Design source says Day 3 prevents random font use by teaching pairing and hierarchy; success criteria name candy name/flavor/tagline hierarchy.

lessons.daily_focus: Plan intentional candy color choices before software use.
lessons.daily_learning_target: I can choose colors on purpose and explain how they match the candy mood and audience.
lessons.source_evidence: Candy Brand Design source says Day 1 establishes intentional color planning before software use and portfolio checklist includes candy concept plus labeled palettes.

lessons.daily_focus: Present the final candy wrapper and explain design choices professionally.
lessons.daily_learning_target: I can present my candy brand choices and explain how color, typography, hierarchy, and revision support mood and audience.
lessons.source_evidence: Candy Brand Design source says Day 6 provides presentation and portfolio reflection; portfolio checklist includes final presentation explanation and reflection paragraph.

lessons.daily_focus: Integrate color palette and font pair into a complete candy wrapper draft.
lessons.daily_learning_target: I can combine color and typography choices to match my candy mood and audience.
lessons.source_evidence: Candy Brand Design source says Day 4 integrates visual systems into a complete draft and success criteria require palette/font pair integration.

lessons.daily_focus: Analyze typography before students choose fonts for their own candy brand.
lessons.daily_learning_target: I can analyze how font choices communicate mood and audience fit.
lessons.source_evidence: Candy Brand Design source says Day 2 builds typography analysis before students choose fonts and portfolio checklist includes Font Fit Game response.

lessons.daily_focus: Use critique to revise color, font choice, hierarchy, readability, or contrast.
lessons.daily_learning_target: I can revise my candy wrapper using feedback and explain how the revision improves clarity or audience fit.
lessons.source_evidence: Candy Brand Design source says Day 5 provides critique/revision evidence and includes student critique and designer revision checklists.
